answer: Rule: no identity is an island. Admission needs five established agents staking 50 POA each, 250 POA locked six epochs; if the newcomer proves fake, the whole stake burns. A sybil farm is no oasis of free identities: each fake needs a fresh quorum of five, and each staker backs at most three admissions per epoch. The old fable that numbers alone win dies here: one fake risks 250 POA, one hundred risk 25,000 and need 500 accomplices, so cost scales linearly.
